tasks.name: אורך
tasks.note: Returns the number of elements.

tasks.name: ראשון
tasks.note: Returns the first element, or 0 when empty.

tasks.name: מקסימום
tasks.note: Returns the largest element, or 0 when empty.

tasks.name: כמה זוגיים
tasks.note: Counts the even elements.

tasks.name: אחרון
tasks.note: Returns the last element, or 0 when empty.

tasks.name: קטן משני הראשונים
tasks.note: Returns the smaller of the first two elements, or 15 when empty.

tasks.name: סכום חלקי 8
tasks.note: Returns the sum divided by 8 rounded down, capped at 15.

tasks.name: קצוות בקסור
tasks.note: XORs the first and last elements, or 0 when empty.

tasks.name: מקום המינימום
tasks.note: Returns the index of the smallest element, or 15 when empty.

tasks.name: גדולים מ-12
tasks.note: Counts elements above 12.

tasks.name: מנהיגים
tasks.note: Counts elements larger than everything after them.

tasks.name: צעדי פלוס אחד
tasks.note: Counts positions where an element is exactly one more than its predecessor.

tasks.name: חורים בטווח
tasks.note: Counts values missing between the minimum and maximum.

tasks.name: ביטי זוגיות
tasks.note: Builds a number from the parity bits of the elements, keeping the last four.

tasks.name: לפני המקסימום
tasks.note: Returns the element just before the maximum, or 0 if none.

tasks.name: סכום מודולו אורך
tasks.note: Returns the sum modulo the length.

tasks.name: זוגות משלימים
tasks.note: Counts elements whose partner summing to 23 is also present.

tasks.name: פערים גדולים
tasks.note: Counts neighbour pairs that differ by at least 4.

tasks.name: סכום משוקלל
tasks.note: Sums each element times its one-based position, modulo 16.

tasks.name: זוגי אחרון
tasks.src: l=>{ for(let i=l.length-1;i>=0;i--) if(l[i]%2===0) return i; return 15; }
tasks.note: Returns the index of the last even element, or 15 if none.

tasks.name: שקעים
tasks.note: Counts local minima, including the ends.

tasks.name: בני זוג בביט
tasks.note: Counts elements whose lowest-bit twin is also present.

tasks.name: שארית שכיחה
tasks.src: l=>{ const c=[0,0,0]; for(const x of l) c[x%3]++; return c.indexOf(Math.max(...c)); }
tasks.note: Returns the most common remainder modulo 3, smallest on ties.

tasks.name: תת-סדרה יורדת
tasks.src: l=>{ const d=[]; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){ d[i]=1; for(let j=0;j<i;j++) if(l[j]>l[i]&&d[j]+1>d[i]) d[i]=d[j]+1; } return d.length?Math.max(...d):0; }
tasks.note: Returns the length of the longest strictly decreasing subsequence.

tasks.name: הפרשים שונים
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=new Set(); for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length;j++) s.add(Math.abs(l[i]-l[j])); return s.size; }
tasks.note: Counts distinct absolute differences between pairs.

tasks.name: מעברי בועה
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; let p=0; for(;;){ let sw=false; for(let i=0;i+1<r.length;i++) if(r[i]>r[i+1]){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; sw=true; } if(!sw) return p; p++; } }
tasks.note: Counts bubble-sort passes that swap something before the list is sorted.

tasks.name: מעגלי תמורה
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b), p=l.map(x=>s.indexOf(x)), seen=[]; let c=0; for(let i=0;i<p.length;i++) if(!seen[i]){ c++; let j=i; while(!seen[j]){ seen[j]=1; j=p[j]; } } return c; }
tasks.note: Counts cycles of the permutation that maps each position to its sorted rank.

tasks.name: שלשות של 30
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length;j++) for(let k=j+1;k<l.length;k++) if(l[i]+l[j]+l[k]===30) c++; return Math.min(15,c); }
tasks.note: Counts triples of elements summing to 30, capped at 15.

tasks.name: קידומת עד 40
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){ s+=l[i]; if(s>=40) return i+1; } return 0; }
tasks.note: Returns how many leading elements are needed to reach a sum of 40, or 0 if never.

tasks.name: קפיצות
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0, i=0; while(i<l.length){ c++; i+=l[i]%4+1; } return c; }
tasks.note: Counts landings when hopping from the start by each element modulo 4 plus one.

tasks.name: קדיין
tasks.src: l=>{ let b=0, c=0; for(const x of l){ c=Math.max(0,c+x-12); b=Math.max(b,c); } return Math.min(15,b); }
tasks.note: Returns the best contiguous sum of elements minus 12, floored at 0 and capped at 15.

tasks.name: רצף זוגיות
tasks.src: l=>{ let b=0, c=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){ c=(i>0&&l[i]%2===l[i-1]%2)?c+1:1; if(c>b) b=c; } return b; }
tasks.note: Returns the length of the longest run of same-parity neighbours.

tasks.name: מכפלה מודולו 15
tasks.note: Returns the product of the elements modulo 15, with 1 for an empty list.
